title: Lucky Bachelor 5 Min to Broadway
description:
The perfect Nashville getaway just five minutes from Broadway! Challenge your group to ping pong, or relax in a stylish, spacious home designed for comfort and fun. Enjoy an open living area, fully-equipped kitchen, and cozy bedrooms. Close to top bars, live music, and nightlife, yet a private retreat when you need it. Book now for the ultimate Music City experience

The space
This modern and spacious home is designed for both relaxation and entertainment, featuring an open-concept living area, a fully equipped kitchen, comfortable bedrooms, and a private backyard and ping pong table—perfect for unwinding after a night out on Broadway

Guest access
Private Entrance with gated yard.

Other things to note
Noise Policy: Quiet hours are from 10 PM to 8 AM out of respect for neighbors.
Parking: Free on-site parking is available.
Ride-Sharing: Uber and Lyft are the best options for getting around downtown quickly.
No Unauthorized Parties: We welcome celebrations but ask that all guests respect the space and neighborhood

Unauthorized late check-outs beyond 30 minutes after the scheduled check-out time may incur a $100 fee, plus additional hourly charges for extended delays or impacts to cleaners and incoming guests.
